ci_support_linux_64_python3.11.____cpyth:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '15'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.11.* *_cpython
python_min:
- '3.11'
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - c_compiler_version
  - cxx_compiler_version
name: ukkonen
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.1.0"

package:
  name: ukkonen
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/u/ukkonen/ukkonen-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: fc62ce0a5b5d57198d4dc0c6ebca406b41afca2b6681af5159a6709b47286377

build:
  number: 1
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cffi >=1
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
  host:
    - python
    - setuptools
    - pip
    - pycparser
    - cffi >=1
  run:
    - python
    - cffi >=1

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - ukkonen
      pip_check: true

about:
  summary: Implementation of bounded Levenshtein distance (Ukkonen)
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - licenses/LICENSE
  homepage: https://www.github.com/asottile/ukkonen

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - tdegeus
    - deadsnakes-issues-bot
